7. **CTA banner / footer sections** — every section after the grid.
8. **Exact CSS values** — extract `.work-card`, `.our-works-grid`, `.filter-sidebar`/`.filter-bar`, `.our-works-pagination`, `.popup`, `.search-input` (or whatever real classes exist) — give padding, border-radius, font-size, color, box-shadow, gap, max-width, breakpoint overrides at 479/767/991/1280/1440px.
9. **CMS row count** — how many portfolio items total, list the 21 expected items with slug + category + image filename.
10. **Categories** — full list with which are Active vs Coming Soon.

Quote exact pixel values, hex colors, class names. Do not paraphrase. Do not summarize sections — list them.
